description.en: Exposes the models already configured in DeepSeek Harness through an OpenAI-compatible gateway, so other local projects can call them with any standard OpenAI client. Multiple provider candidates share one named group with ordered, balanced or random dispatch; upstream failures before any output switch to the next candidate transparently, and rate-limited requests are retried after the provider's backoff. Per-candidate call statistics (attempts, answers, failures, token/TTFT totals) appear as badges in the settings page, and daily aggregates persist to a local file with a 30-day heatmap and trend view. Until you create a key in the UI, the endpoint accepts calls from anyone who can reach it; keys (stored as SHA-256 hashes) then turn authentication on, and the endpoint stays locked even after the last key is revoked. Exposing the optional LAN listener without a key leaves the port open to the whole network. Runs on DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 through 0.1.7-alpha.1 and later.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 里已配置好的模型通过 OpenAI 兼容网关中转出去，其他本地项目 用标准 OpenAI 客户端即可调用。多个供应商候选共享一个具名分组，支持顺序、均衡、 随机三种调度；上游在产出任何内容前失败时自动切换下一候选，客户端无感，被限流的 请求按供应商指示的退避时间自动重试。每条候选的调用统计（尝试、应答、失败、 token/TTFT 累计）以徽章形式显示在设置页，按天聚合的数据落盘为本地文件，附 30 天 热力图与趋势视图。在界面创建密钥之前，接口对任何能访问到它的人开放；创建密钥 （仅存 SHA-256 哈希）后开启校验，且删掉最后一个密钥仍保持锁定，需显式关闭鉴权 才会重新开放。若启用可选的局域网监听而未配密钥，该端口对整个局域网开放。支持 DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 至 0.1.7-alpha.1 及以后。

description.en: Puts the DSH web UI on a phone browser over your own tailnet, with the remote channel built on Tailscale Serve. Both sides need only Tailscale: no dedicated app, no QR code, no login page, no account of its own, and no relay of your content. The desktop half runs on macOS, Windows or Linux.
description.zh: 让手机浏览器直接使用电脑上的 DSH 网页界面，远程通道建立在 Tailscale Serve 之上。两边除了 Tailscale 不用再装任何东西：没有专用 App、没有二维码、没有登录页，插件不设账号，也不中转你的内容。电脑端支持 macOS、Windows 与 Linux。

description.en: Registers the TypeSafe/Jev (System One) skill into DeepSeek Harness's global skill layer, so every session can classify, route, score, extract and gate on confidence using typed judgments instead of prompt-and-parse. Ships no API key; the user supplies OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
description.zh: 把 TypeSafe / Jev（System One 判断模型）的构建技能注册进 DeepSeek Harness 的全局技能层，让每个会话都能用带类型的判断做分类、路由、打分、抽取和置信度门控，取代「调大模型再解析回复」。不含任何密钥，API key 由使用者通过 OPENROUTER_API_KEY 提供。

description.en: Restart button for DSH Desktop placed directly above the sidebar account button.
description.zh: 用于重启 DSH 桌面的按钮，直接放在侧边栏账号按钮上方。
